verdict.rationale: Adyen's own docs describe merchant-side agentic checkout: AI agents such as Gemini, ChatGPT and Copilot can make purchases, and shoppers can complete transactions without leaving the AI agent. This runs over the ACP and UCP checkout flows, with a Cart API for stock, tax, shipping and authorization, plus a dedicated Google AI Mode/Gemini integration. missing for 10: Claude is not named as a supported surface, no independent or hands-on corroboration of live in-chat purchases.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)

citations.quote: Agentic Commerce enables AI agents like Gemini, ChatGPT, and Copilot to act on behalf of shoppers. For example, AI agents can find products, compare options, and make purchases.
shoppers can make complete transactions without leaving the interaction with your AI agent.
Adyen communicates with your server so that you do not need to integrate with multiple agent platforms.
when Google agents (Google AI Mode or Gemini) initiate transactions with you.
Adyen handles the communication with our merchants and the downstream complexity of orchestrating stock validation, tax calculation, shipping, and payment authorization.
